scope: Exact installed Neuron worker/model-runner/model-loader and vLLM startup, memory-profile and warmup call flow; source-only, no lifecycle/process audit.
conclusion: With ordinary single-data-parallel engine configuration, reviewed initialization and warmup do not invoke the hooked runner.cpu_sampler.topk_topp_sampler. There is a distinct dummy-batch path in the data-parallel engine loop, so this conclusion is conditional on actual configuration and is not a blanket assertion that Neuron never attempts dummy sampling.
normal_startup: qwen35_sampler_instance_v1.py worker factory attaches hooks only to the newly constructed runner.cpu_sampler instance; no global sampler class patch.
vllm/executor/uniproc_executor.py:53-55 initializes worker/device and loads model.
vllm_neuron/worker/neuron_worker.py:51-63 determine_available_memory reads runtime memory statistics, not a model profile run.
vllm/v1/engine/core.py:169-207 initializes KV cache via executor; v1/executor/abstract.py:67-75 calls initialize_from_config and compile_or_warm_up_model.
Neuron worker compile_or_warm_up_model at lines88-90 returns immediately; runner initialize_kv_cache at lines145-153 also returns immediately.
Runner load_model at lines215-238 loads the model and validates configuration, without invoking runner CPU sampling.
Neuron loader _load_compiled_model at lines214-218 calls the NxDI application load method.
qwen35_neuron_adapter.py NeuronQwen35ForCausalLM inherits NeuronBaseForCausalLM, which inherits NeuronApplicationBase; neither defines a load/warmup override.
NxDI application_base.py:339-362 warmup calls the compiled nxd_model.forward or forward_async directly for generated example inputs. It does not call the vLLM model runner or its CPU sampler.
Normal EngineCoreProc loop at v1/engine/core.py:720-728 processes queued actual work without execute_dummy_batch.

separate_dummy_path.automatic_callsite: vllm/v1/engine/core.py:1056 inside DPEngineCoreProc.run_busy_loop; constructor selection at lines689-699 uses this variant for data_parallel_size>1 or dp_rank>0.
separate_dummy_path.request_context_limitation: Dummy input uses request_ids=[dummy_request] but does not populate runner.requests, input_batch request membership or sampling metadata with a corresponding real request.
separate_dummy_path.empty_batch_behavior: Fresh input_batch has no requests. Both all_greedy and all_random are true by gpu_input_batch.py:832-837. This must not be described as an ordinary greedy bypass: empty reordered logits can fail debug reduction in _cpu_sample; if sampler.sample were reached, its mutually-exclusive flag assertion at lines153-154 would fail before topk/topp.
separate_dummy_path.nonempty_batch_behavior: If an unrelated active input_batch remains, reordering looks up actual request IDs in the dummy request mapping and can fail before sampling.
separate_dummy_path.exception_handling: The original _dummy_run catches Exception at lines1438-1441 and logs a warning. These observations do not qualify dummy inference as successful.
separate_dummy_path.source_risk_classification: No demonstrated startup-quota consumption in the reviewed ordinary single-DP path. Any configuration or future dummy path that reaches non-greedy topk with synthetic context requires explicit validation and may need a separately reviewed hook design.

configuration_scope.frozen_args: qwen35_sampler_pair_driver_v1.py:66-71 sets TP2, batch4 and context4096; it does not set a DP flag.
configuration_scope.default: vllm/config/parallel.py:71 and :76 defaults are data_parallel_size1 and data_parallel_rank0.
configuration_scope.environment_override: vllm/config/parallel.py:406-412 can replace these values from VLLM_DP_SIZE/VLLM_DP_RANK environment values; no live environment or process was inspected.
configuration_scope.required: Actual native startup evidence must confirm intended single-DP configuration.

quota_caveat: CaptureObserver observed_operation at lines214-218 increments call_id and budget.select before request_context. Zero written packets alone does not prove no failed-context calls consumed seen quota.
required_native_evidence: Actual intended single-DP startup reaches ready without capture/context exceptions.
No capture packets before first diagnostic request; if observer counters are available, call_id and seen counts must also be zero.
Complete actual B1 and B4 diagnostic captures each contain the original16 selected calls, with no missing records or silently consumed quota.
Do not report this source review as native startup success.
